title: A handful of acorns
description: Adds seasonal nuts harvestable with Long Secateurs to TerraFirmaCraft
body:
Have you ever wanted to know why you can not harvest chestnuts in tfc where the chestnut trees abound?

Since I am a chowhound, I made this mod for those who have the same question.

Now you can harvest **chestnuts, pinecones, hickory nuts and acorn**s in tfc like real.

First you need a right tool called **_Long Secateurs_**   See this in gallery.

Then you need to find a **VALID BLOCK**(such as chestnut tree leaves block) in **RIGHT SEASON**(9, 10, 11th)

Finally, use the Long Secateurs on the block, you may **have a chance** to cut a nut for dinner. **Some nuts can be roasted.**

FOR **pine nuts**, you need **a knife and a pinecone to craft it**
